title: Hum dimaag ka sirf 10% use karte hain?
source: MIT McGovern Institute · Britannica · Association for Psychological Science

title: KYA BAAT
FACTS
source_card.sub: MIT McGovern Institute · Britannica · Association for Psychological Science

claims.claim: The idea that we use only 10% of our brain is a myth
We use our entire brain every day; it is constantly active, even at rest
The brain is about 2% of body weight but uses about 20% of the body's energy (calories)
If only 10% were needed, most brain injuries would have no effect; in fact almost any damaged area causes some loss
claims.ref: Britannica; Wikipedia (Ten percent of the brain myth)

shots.en: Brain scans show that over a day... we use our whole brain. Even while resting!

shots.en: And think about it... the brain is only two percent of our body weight... but it uses twenty percent of our energy! Kya baat hai!
units: [excited] और सोचो... दिमाग़ हमारे शरीर के वज़न का सिर्फ़ दो प्रतिशत है... लेकिन खाता है बीस प्रतिशत energy!

shots.en: If ninety percent were really useless... brain injuries wouldn't matter. But an injury to almost any part has some effect.

caption:
Kya hum dimaag ka sirf 10% use karte hain? ❌ MYTH! Brain scans dikhate hain ki hum din bhar poora dimaag use karte hain. Dimaag body weight ka sirf 2% hai, par 20% energy khaata hai! 🧠

Sources: MIT McGovern Institute, Britannica, APS.
